description:
The closed F_5 receipt campaign's receipts deny a committed per-lane register statement that the kernel source itself carries, so the receipts' prediction-coverage story is false for both F_5 prototype kernels.

## Background

`dev/studies/91605d4d/receipts.md` states that no committed design states a per-lane register budget for the F_5 prototype kernels — the bolded claim near line 883, the per-kernel coverage table in section 7.2 (lines 967–979), the REQ-07 conformance row (line 1486), and the section-17 limitation entry (line 1519) all render it. The committed kernel source contradicts this: `dev/research/permanent_wave_gpu/hip/f5_wave_equivalence.hip:9-15` states source-level stable-lane-state models for both kernels — `f5_byte_control_kernel` at $n + 20$ bytes and `f5_three_plane_kernel` at 11 32-bit register units — as explicit register/shared-memory hypotheses before compiler allocation, with the compiler resource report named authoritative for the final counts.

The F_3 receipts (`dev/studies/047b62ed/receipts.md`) already pair exactly this kind of source-level lower bound (the $\ge 9 \times$ 32-bit statement) with the measured figures; per `@/inv/convention-convergence` that pairing is the convention. The identical defect in the F_7 receipts was found by 6c7fcb38's code-review gate and is being fixed under that issue; this issue owns the F_5 instance, which lives in a closed campaign.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every rendering in `dev/studies/91605d4d/receipts.md` of the claim that no committed design states a per-lane register budget for a kernel whose committed source does state one is corrected: the section-7.1 table, the section-7.2 coverage table, the conformance-table rows, and the section-17 limitation entry pair the measured registers with the source-stated model as a source-level lower bound in the source's own units (with any unit conversion stated), following the F_3 receipts' pairing convention, each with its source file:line citation.
- [hard] REQ-02: Where a measurement sits at or above its stated lower bound the pairing states the confirmation; a measurement below the bound is recorded together with the contradiction per `@/inv/falsification-preserved`. Claims of absence for kernels whose sources genuinely state no per-lane register model are left standing, each verified against its source.
- [hard] REQ-03: The receipts' analysis script still reproduces every rendered figure after the edit, and no measurement artifact, CSV, or evidence file is modified.

## Notes

Doc-only correction of a closed study's receipts; measurement evidence is untouched per `@/inv/behavioral-evidence-validity`. Found by the F_7 code-review finding on 6c7fcb38 (gate-run record of 2026-08-16); same root cause: the receipt author searched the README for budget statements and missed the HIP translation-unit headers.
title: F_5 receipts deny committed per-lane register models their kernel source states
